as_told.title: Puharich meditates in the King's Chamber

plain: There are said to be tape recordings of Andrija Puharich, a scientist the episode's title calls a CIA scientist who made contact with an alien council, meditating inside the King's Chamber, a granite room deep inside the Great Pyramid of Egypt. Both tellings come from a single episode, about Puharich, where researchers talk about what they have found. A researcher named Greg Malatzi says, "We have tape recordings of him meditating in the King's Chamber." Another guest, whose name is not given, adds the year: "in '76," and the host answers "What?" in surprise. The story fits with other 1970s accounts of scientific work inside the pyramid. It matters because it would show Puharich trying to reach other beings from inside one of the world's most mysterious buildings.
